item.title: Active Conditions
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.content:encoded:
Active Medical Conditions

Primary Diagnosis

Stage IV (Metastatic) Colorectal Adenocarcinoma

  • Diagnosed: November 8, 2023
  • Grade: Grade 2 (moderately differentiated)
  • Primary Site: Colon
  • Metastatic Sites: Liver (multiple, bilobar)
  • Genomic Profile:
    • MSS (Microsatellite Stable)
    • KRAS wild-type
    • TP53 mutated
  • Performance Status: ECOG 0-1
  • Status: Active, on systemic chemotherapy

Secondary Conditions

Hypertension

  • Onset: ~2010
  • Management: Antihypertensive medications
  • Stability: Well-controlled

Hyperlipidemia

  • Onset: ~2012
  • Management: Statin therapy
  • Stability: Well-controlled

Obesity

  • BMI Category: Overweight to Obese range
  • Status: Ongoing management

Treatment-Related Conditions

Chemotherapy Side Effects (Ongoing)

  • Peripheral neuropathy (FOLFIRI-related)
  • Occasional nausea/vomiting
  • Fatigue
  • Hand-foot syndrome (potential with Bevacizumab)

Port Placement

  • Central venous port for chemotherapy administration
  • Status: Active, functioning

Allergies

  • No known drug allergies (NKDA)
  • No known food allergies

See Active Medications for current treatment regimen.
